svg.title: CoSTOS HAT PT edition mockup, top view
svg.desc: Raspberry Pi HAT, 65 by 56.5 millimetres, PT edition with one LTC2983: a two-level terminal block with eight Pt1000 inputs and a 1-Wire terminal on the left edge, the LTC2983 with its shared sense resistor and input protection, and the same power, relay, pump and watchdog section as the 1-Wire edition.
svg.text: Top view to scale (1 mm = 8 px). Field connectors: fixed 3.5 mm screw terminals; S1–S8 and PUMP1 on the left, 1W-A at the front.
